EURINR.trade_impact: Directly impacts European export realization for Indian auto ancillaries, textiles, and chemicals

us_10y_treasury_regimes.emerging_market_impact: Strong capital inflows into Indian equities, high PE multiple expansion
Balanced valuation regime, earnings-driven market leadership
Dollar strength, FII rotation from Emerging Markets into risk-free US paper

tax_provisions.section_115bbh: Flat 30% tax on gains from VDA transfers (No deduction for expenses other than acquisition cost, no loss set-off against other income)
tax_provisions.section_194s: 1% TDS deducted at source on every transfer exceeding Rs 50,000 in a financial year
